sources.title: World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, File 21
sources.conversion: Multiply stored thousands by 1000; reject non-integer-person precision beyond 0.00001 person, then remove binary float noise. Stored precision up to 0.001 thousand; inspected Excel cells display whole thousands (#,##0).
sources.coordinateDatum: Geographic decimal degrees; WGS84 interpretation for orbital display. F21 does not explicitly state datum. No reprojection performed.
sources.attribution: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2025). World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, Online Edition. Sample selection and unit conversion by Population Earth.
sources.namePolicy: Retain City_Name verbatim as the publisher display name in nameEn, including romanized names and parenthetical English variants. No separately verified local-script names.
sources.displayPrecisionNote: Show approximate rounded thousands; stored values do not establish person-level accuracy.

definitions.label: City (Degree of Urbanization, WUP 2025)
definitions.description: Publisher harmonized city definition using population, density and contiguity on 1 km² grids. At least 50,000 inhabitants and high-density areas at least 1,500 inhabitants/km²; see full methodology for grid rules. Not city proper or a nationally defined metropolitan area.

basis: UN WUP 2025 F21, DEGURBA cities with a published mid-year 2025 value of at least 50,000 people; not all people or settlements.
